expected.fmt:
import (
	Bytes, BytesBuilder from "@std/bytes.ms",
	PriorityQueue, Queue from "@std/collections/queue.ms",
	from_int, parse_int from "@std/math/math.ms",
	expect_equal, expect_false from "@std/test/test.ms",
)

test "byte updates retain relative bounds and immutable storage":
	bytes := Bytes([0, 255])
	expect_equal(bytes.with_value(-2, 255), Bytes([255, 255]))?
	expect_equal(bytes.with_value(1, 0), Bytes([0, 0]))?
	expect_equal(bytes, Bytes([0, 255]))?
	expect_equal(bytes.get(-3, default: 7), 7)?
	expect_equal(bytes.get(2, default: 7), 7)?
	expect_equal(bytes.slice(2, 2).get(), Bytes([]))?

	var builder = BytesBuilder()
	builder.append(0)
	builder.append(255)
	expect_equal(builder.build(), bytes)?

test "list boundaries retain mutation truncation and empty ranges":
	var list = [1, 2]
	list.set(-2, 0)
	expect_equal(list, [0, 2])?
	list.remove(-1)
	expect_false(list != [0] or list != [0])?
	list.splice(1, 0, [1, 2])
	list.fill(9, 3, 3)
	list.copy_within(3, 0, 3)
	expect_equal(list, [0, 1, 2])?
	list.copy_within(2, 0, 3)
	expect_equal(list, [0, 1, 0])?
	list.splice(0, 3, [])
	list.fill(1, 0, 0)
	list.copy_within(0, 0, 0)
	list.splice(0, 0, [])
	expect_equal(list.length(), 0)?
	expect_equal(list.get(0, default: -1), -1)?

test "radix formatting retains inclusive boundaries and parse errors":
	expect_false(
		((35).to_string_radix(2) != "100011" or (35).to_string_radix(36) != "z")
	)?

	big := from_int(35)
	expect_false((big.to_string_radix(2) != "100011" or big.to_string_radix(36) != "z"))?

	invalid: Int! := error(Error("number: invalid input", kind: "EINVAL"))
	expect_equal(parse_int("1", 1), invalid)?
	expect_false(not "invalid".parse_int().is_none())?

test "queue capacities retain omission none minimum maximum and full results":
	var queue = Queue[Int](1)
	expect_false(not queue.enqueue(1) or queue.enqueue(2))?
	expect_false(queue.dequeue() != 1 or not queue.dequeue().is_none())?

	var unbounded = Queue[Int](none)
	var large = Queue[Int](9223372036854775807)
	expect_false(not unbounded.enqueue(1) or not large.enqueue(1))?

	var priority = PriorityQueue[Int](1)
	expect_false(not priority.enqueue(1) or priority.enqueue(2))?

	var unlimited = PriorityQueue[Int](none)
	var large_priority = PriorityQueue[Int](9223372036854775807)
	expect_false(not unlimited.enqueue(1) or not large_priority.enqueue(1))?
